card.name: SciELO journal citation metadata
card.fires_on: Words and symbols in SciELO-style article headers and citations, such as 'versión impresa', 'ISSN', '[online]', 'vol.' and 'n.' after a Spanish or Latin American journal title.

modes.label: Print edition line
modes.description: The words 'versión impresa' and the ISSN label that follows them under a journal title.
modes.example: Revista Panamericana de Salud Pública vers<<ión>> impresa ISSN 1020

modes.label: Citation fields
modes.description: Punctuation and field labels in a reference after the journal name, such as [online], vol. and n.
modes.example: Rev Panam Salud Publica [online]. 2001,<< vol>>.9, n.6, pp

card.plain: It fires on the catalogue-style details in Latin American journal citations, such as print edition, ISSN, volume and issue.
